terbaru.judul: Retained hidden excess generates memory in price-limited markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a minimal stochastic latent-state model in which a fraction of this hidden excess is retained for the next day.

terbaru.judul: Microstructural Foundation for the Rough Hawkes--Heston Model
terbaru.pelajaran: Hawkes-based microstructural foundations for rough volatility, leverage, and rough Heston-type limits were developed by El Euch et al.

terbaru.judul: On a Simple Relationship Between Order Imbalance, Skew and Width in Over-The-Counter Trading
terbaru.pelajaran: We consider a market maker who can only obtain and dispose of inventory by responding to a sequence of sealed-bid enquiries, and whose customers arrive with imbalanced intent: sellers more often than buyers, or the reverse.

terbaru.judul: Velocity- and Regime-Aware Detection of Intraday Options Market Manipulation, with Explainable Attribution
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that this manipulation leaves a distinctive dynamic signature: a pump-and-crash pattern visible in the velocity of market state, rather than its level.

terbaru.judul: Mandate without Managers: Automated Market Makers as Verifiable Portfolio Products
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a multi-asset fee structure to the G3M under which competitive arbitrage implements a band-rebalancing strategy with mis-weighting bounded ex ante, allowing compliance with the mandate to be verified directly from the pool's observable holdings.

terbaru.judul: Exactly solvable model for the diffusive price-dynamics paradox under long-range correlated market-order flow
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we resolve this diffusive price-dynamics paradox by developing nonlinear time-series models that generalize the LMF model based on the square-root price-impact law.

terbaru.judul: Optimal Trading of Microstructure Mean Reversion
terbaru.pelajaran: At the scale of seconds the observed mid carries a stationary, mean-reverting error around a latent efficient price.

terbaru.judul: Axient: On-Chain Credit and Loss Allocation for Leveraged Event Markets: A Venue-Agnostic Protocol for Traders, Credit Providers, Market Makers, and Liquidation Backstops
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper develops a venue-agnostic on-chain credit architecture for that capital layer and an endogenous model of its capital market.

terbaru.judul: Axient: Debt-Free Finality for Leveraged Binary Event Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper specifies Axient, a physically backed margin layer for binary event markets that separates leverage maturity from claim maturity and makes the hard-flat decision under explicit execution uncertainty.

terbaru.judul: Train Often, Deploy Selectively: Forward-Gated Model Replacement in Crypto Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Shadow Before Swap (SBS), a deployment policy that warm-refits a challenger off the serving path, evaluates it against the maintained incumbent on the same next week of delayed labels, and promotes it only after a fixed paired negative-log-likelihood (NLL) advantage.
